items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to the fixing and collecting of rates and charges by the Cayuga county water and sewer authority
items.lawCode: Amd §1199-eeee, ren §§1199-xxxx & 1199-yyyy to be §§1199-yyyy & 1199-zzzz, add §1199-xxxx, Pub Auth L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6304

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the public authorities law, in relation to the fixing
and collecting of rates and charges by the Cayuga county water and
sewer authority


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
This bill allows the Cayuga County Water and Sewer Authority to place
a lien on the real property of individuals who are in arrears on their
water and/or sewerage payments.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
This bill stipulates that no rates or charges shall be changed until a
public hearing is held with no less than 14 days notice to customers
either by mail or publication in a newspaper having general
circulation within the bounds of the authority. Notice will include
date, time and place of hearing and also a brief description of
matters to be considered at meeting. A copy of the notice shall be
available for inspection by the public.  At the hearing, interested
persons shall have an opportunity to be heard concerning matters under
consideration. Any decisions by the authority regarding matters
discussed at the hearing shall be in writing and available for public
inspection during regular business hours.

A lien shall be placed upon the real property for any unpaid rates,
fees or other charges for the facilities, services or commodities
provided by the Authority. Any such lien shall take precedent over all
other liens, or encumbrances, except taxes or assessments. The
treasurer of the Authority shall prepare a list of those properties in
arrears. The County Legislature shall publish the list in a separate
column in the annual tax rolls of the county under the heading "water
charge" or "sewer disposal charge". When collected, the amount due
will be paid to the treasurer of the Authority; penalties and interest
will become part of the general funds of the county.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Cayuga County Legislature has requested this bill to allow the
Cayuga County Water and Sewer Authority to collect delinquent water
and sewer charges through charges on their county tax bills. Given
that the Authority currently does not have this ability it can and
does create collection problems which are even more noticed for sewer
services given that there is no practical way to temporarily shut off
sewer services to a nonpaying customer as it would render a building
uninhabitable. Thus by allowing this the Authority will be able to
collect what it is rightfully owed to keep the water flowing and the
sewers working. This particular bill is based on Chapter 637 of the
Laws of 2002 which authorized the Livingston County Water and Sewer
Authority.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
